# clean-simd operation matrix

Generated from the kernel tables in `tools/gen_simd/`, the same tables the code is generated from.
An operator exists where AVX2, NEON and SIMD128 each implement the operation in at most three lane-wise instructions; [design.md](design.md#the-operator-rule) has the rule.
Every operation also has a member of the same name, whatever it costs.

## Emulated operations

What each kernel has no instruction or short sequence for, at its widest register.
These are correct everywhere, and slower than their neighbours.

**sse2**

- `round`: f32, f64
- `floor`: f32, f64
- `ceil`: f32, f64
- `trunc`: f32, f64
- `to_i64`: f64
- `mul`: i8, i32, i64, u8, u32, u64
- `mul_add`: i8, i32, i64, u8, u32, u64
- `shr`: i8
- `gt`: i64, u64
- `lt`: i64, u64
- `le`: i64, u64
- `ge`: i64, u64
- `min`: i64, u64
- `max`: i64, u64
- `abs`: i64
- `to_f64`: i64, u64
- `to_f32`: u32
